steps.content: Script Impression Show Cast The World's Strongest Lord OwO! Time During the shooting breaks Location Studio OwO: It's official! Lord OwO is going to shoot an impression show!!! Photographer Duck: Quack quack quack? （(Who are you trying to imitate?) OwO: Hehe! This pretty blue-haired lady on this wall painting! OwO: It's an audience request to watch OwO dance! Photographer Duck: Quack quack... Quack quack quack quack... （Are you sure? These dances are difficult...）

OwO: Of course OwO can do it! Heck, believe it or not! Photographer Duck: Quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack... Quack quack... Quack! (Dancing is not just posing, you have to also keep up with the tempo... Hey, hey, hey! Stop!) OwO: Baaah... @_@... It's... too fast... Gaffer Duck: Quack quack quack quack quack quack...
